# Env Threeview / Reference

## Storage

```
projects/excelion/design/env/<kit-name>/
```

Read each kit's DESCRIPTION.md before generating reference images or notes.

## Rules

- Prefer clear orthographic or simple 3/4 reference when useful for modeling
- Mood and silhouette readability first (BRAVE vs ORD contrast)
- Reuse earth kits for both siege (공성) and defense (수성) by changing objective only
